bracket.words: The chat showed Saved to memory, but the note is waiting for your approval and is not in MEMORY.md.

summary.facts: The check facts (all true): the memory row in the chat is titled Saved to memory but its result says the save was staged for approval and not yet saved; a held save sits in the profile's pending/memory folder; MEMORY.md is unchanged (479 of 2,200 characters, no line holds the fact); the new chat did NOT use the fact (it asked which software Harbor Bakery uses); the fact the learner wanted saved is 'Harbor Bakery uses QuickBooks Online; the other five use Xero'.
